// why: Shared compiler options for the QuickJS mods (each mod folder's tsconfig.json extends this).
Based on the jsconfig.json `herdr-app check` generates: same target, lib and module resolution.
noImplicitAny is ON: an untyped parameter is an error until it gets a JSDoc type.
strictNullChecks off: view state is assigned in init(), which TypeScript can't see as definite assignment.
useUnknownInCatchVariables off: the mods read e?.message in catch blocks everywhere.
skipLibCheck: gpui-kit.d.ts is generated by Herdr and has a few errors of its own.
